title: Oasis at Gulf Place | KEY.co
description_expanded: Tucked within the sought-after Gulf Place community along scenic 30A, this coastal-chic retreat is a perfect blend of luxury, style, and convenience. Designed with a light, airy aesthetic and thoughtful finishes throughout, the two-story home offers an open-concept first floor with a sleek kitchen, inviting dining area, and a spacious living room that opens to your own private outdoor oasis. The fenced-in backyard features a sparkling pool, built-in grill, covered patio, and plenty of seating—ideal for everything from sun-soaked afternoons to twilight dinners under the stars. With a six-seater golf cart included, beach days and evening trips to the charming Gulf Place Town Center are just a breeze away. Pool heat at private home pools, if it is available, is offered seasonally between October and Early May, however, pools cannot be heated if the temperature is below fifty two (52) degrees or above eighty (80) degrees. For an additional cost the pool can be heated. Pool Heat must be purchased for entire/duration of stay and will be billed at the time of request for units that have a heater. Please coordinate with KEY for details about the additional cost. Allow forty-eight (48) hours for the pool heater to heat the pool water to the set temperature. Tampering with pool equipment may result in injury and/or a fine. All pool equipment must be operated by a licensed professional.
